LESSON: MASS, VOLUME, WEIGHT AND DENSITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.2 Volume of Solids (8 lessons) • Volume of triangular and rectang
Topic 3.3: Mass, Volume, Weight and Density

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Mass, Volume, Weight and Density. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply density to real-life situations
2. recognise the use of density in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MASS, VOLUME, WEIGHT AND DENSITY
Mass, Volume, Weight and Density is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Mass, Volume, Weight and Density problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Mass, Volume, Weight and Density question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Mass, Volume, Weight and Density question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Mass, Volume, Weight and Density set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Mass, Volume, Weight and Density.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Mass, Volume, Weight and Density in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply density to real-life situations
2. recognise the use of density in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
